title: API code journey montage for async streaming + tool integration
creator: Lena Park
description: Create a compact, developer-focused visual montage for the API/SDK onboarding docs that demonstrates: key-based auth, streaming token reveal, and tool-calling flows. Deliver a set of static screenshots, animated microloops (Lottie + APNG), and annotated code-card overlays intended for the quickstart page, SDK guides, and the Console release notes.
acceptance_criteria: One 1200x600 hero montage image (light + dark) that sequences: auth -> first call -> streaming tokens -> tool call completion
Three annotated code-card PNGs (auth header, streaming client snippet, toolcall payload) with copy-ready microcopy
Two Lottie microloops: streaming token reveal (3s) and toolcall confirmation badge (2s)
Exported assets uploaded to Drive and linked in the ticket; figma file finalized and published to the docs team
Motion spec and accessibility notes (alt text, color contrast, reduced motion variants) included
updates: 2026-03-08 - Lena Park: Kickoff — scoped hero montage and three code-cards. Agreed with PM (J. Howell) to prioritize streaming reveal visual because it answers the most developer questions during first-run.

2026-03-09 - Evan Morrison: Sketches uploaded to Figma; prototyped token-by-token micro-animation using staged frames. Noted edge-case: when streaming with partial tool metadata the UI should show a placeholder badge — decision to show 'Pending tool' visual.
2026-03-10 - Product review (J. Howell): Requested copy edits to the auth card to emphasize 'rotate keys' link; suggested adding a concise error state for failed toolcall to reduce support questions.

2026-03-11 - Engineering sync (ENG-2289 owner - Priya Singh): Confirmed streaming SDK now exposes onToken callback; will ship minor API addendum documented in PR. Dependency satisfied for animation hooks.

2026-03-12 - Design review: Internal review passed; requested reduced-motion variant and accessible color adjustments. Evan created exports and uploaded Lottie + APNG to Drive. Ready for docs handoff pending final copy approval.
2026-03-12 - Follow-up tasks created: link to copy PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4012) and handoff checklist assigned to docs writer (Marta Ruiz).
comments: Marta Ruiz (2026-03-12): Need final alt-text strings before I can publish. Will coordinate with Evan for descriptive copy.
Priya Singh (2026-03-11): Small ask from infra — please include a frame showing missing KV cache fallback when streaming is interrupted.
J. Howell (PM) (2026-03-09): Strong preference for hero montage to be modular so we can reuse it on the Console release notes and the SDK quickstart. Keep layers separated in Figma.
risks: Animation relies on new SDK onToken callback; if the ENG patch slips we fallback to a static GIF sequence (lower fidelity).
Motion and color choices may conflict with existing docs theme — required coordination with Docs theme team could add 1-2 days.
Large Lottie payloads may increase page weight; assets must be lazy-loaded and have a static PNG fallback for low-bandwidth users.
design_decisions: Use progressive reveal: show auth card -> call snippet -> streaming tokens appearing incrementally -> toolcall badge with success microcopy
Compact vertical rhythm: each micro-card 280px wide so montage can be recomposed for mobile stacks
Provide reduced-motion and high-contrast variants to meet WCAG guidance; include textual copy of streaming progress for screen readers

Docs writer (Marta): review and merge copy PR, reference images in quickstart (due 2026-03-16)
